Change only the depicted identities and their clothing. Keep the source stylized 3D animation materials, scene geometry, dark palette, lighting direction, depth of field, exact framing, camera route and pose timing. Keep the visible props and effects from the source wherever they occur. Maintain their screen silhouettes, reflections and positions. The two role designs have equivalent height and body proportions in the same camera plane. Keep this original single cut, camera path, background and all non-character screen elements. Match its existing action timing and pose changes from first to last frame. review.observations: 逐帧核对原片第 510–535 帧和交付的全部 26 帧。候选保持虚人梦的金发、红兜帽、左肩一张面具、暗色手套及裤靴，原片高机位和木地板、碎墙、左侧柜子及右侧粉椅均可辨。重新取同一镜的模型帧，依次对齐靠近镜头的双手、退后的屈膝、两手下落、侧转抬掌和交臂收势。中段披风让膝部的外轮廓更窄，几处手掌离身体的距离较小。逐帧对应下，角色、动作顺序和连续机位均通过。
